scope: P0 closure assessment from frozen post-fix preparation batches; historical p0-20261010 acceptance.json unchanged.

item1_crash.root_cause: LockstepScheduler caller-mutex lifetime race (batch-02 core, tests/lockstep_lifetime_test.cpp reproduces, fixed in research/platform/lockstep_scheduler.cpp)
item1_crash.not_proven: The p0 raptor-hover-01 SIGSEGV has no stack; a dangling caller stack mutex is consistent with it but not proven.

item2_startup.not_proven: Multi-NIC endpoint selection remains a hypothesis, not a demonstrated root cause.

gate.basis: Claude-proposed (user delegated): one physics step is the lockstep floor; 12 ms is below the 12.5 ms rotor rise time constant in the x500 SDF.

item3_output_chain.condition: Tail latency depends on host load (batch mean CPU 22.5% vs 14.1%); evaluated across both instrumented batches.

p0_complete_note: batch-04 stopped on the fixed-reference recovery criterion (since replaced, user-confirmed); its flights still count for crash, startup and output-chain evidence. Final verdict uses batch-05 as the complete frozen batch.
